package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type TelegramStore interface {
	TelegramLinkStore
	TelegramDeliveryStore
}

type TelegramLinkStore interface {
	IssueLinkCode(context.Context, [32]byte, domain.TelegramLinkRecord) error
	ConsumeLinkCode(context.Context, [32]byte, int64, int64, time.Time) (domain.TelegramBinding, error)
	GetBindingByChat(context.Context, int64, int64) (domain.TelegramBinding, error)
}

type TelegramDeliveryStore interface {
	EnqueueDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error
	ClaimDelivery(context.Context, string, time.Time, time.Time) (domain.TelegramDelivery, bool, error)
	MarkDeliverySent(context.Context, string, string, int64, time.Time) error
	RetryDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error
	BlockDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error
}

type TelegramSender interface {
	SendText(context.Context, int64, string) (int64, error)
}

type TelegramDeliveryEnqueuer interface {
	EnqueueDelivery(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error
}
